info.description: The stable routes and the dev.zm.* event payloads of a zm daemon (docs/clients.md). Generated from the Go types by scripts/clientschema; never edit it by hand. In a response body a required field is always present, any other may be absent, and a field added within potluck/1 is never required. No schema forbids unknown properties or lists a string's values: a newer daemon adds both, so validate with any JSON Schema 2020-12 validator and ignore what you do not know. Event data (the ...Data schemas) and request bodies (...Request, ...Input) require nothing: an event may be older than a field or carry fewer keys for some readers, and an absent request field is its zero value. The daemon refuses a request field it does not know (400). Query parameters, headers and guards are in API.md. Each event's data is the schema named by its type under components.schemas.
